Description: BMOAS private ECS services. Initialise Atlas before starting these services.

ImageUri.Description: Immutable ECR image tag or digest

ResponsiveScaling.Description: Enable scaling of all processing stages and faster scale-out alarms. false retains aggregation CPU scaling only.

QueueBacklogThreshold.Description: Provisional visible-message threshold for adding capacity. Calibrate with matched experiments.

QueueAgeThreshold.Description: Oldest visible message age in seconds before urgent scale-out.

NodeRedMinimumTasks.Description: Capacity available before demand. Report separately from reactive scaling.

ValidatorMinimumTasks.Description: Capacity available before demand. Report separately from reactive scaling.

AggregatorMinimumTasks.Description: Capacity available before demand. Report separately from reactive scaling.

ScheduledCapacity.Description: Enable illustrative audience-based capacity timetable. Review schedules against actual ratings and programme times.
